subject: FY24 Superintendent's Budget Recommendation
overview: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented a $71.8 million FY24 budget proposal focusing on literacy initiatives, vocational expansion, and elementary schedule changes. The committee discussed the anticipated fiscal gap in FY25 resulting from the expiration of federal pandemic relief funds.

items.title: FY24 Budget Overview and Strategic Priorities
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented a $71.8 million operating budget for FY24 built around achievement, collaboration, equity, and safety.

items.title: Fixed Costs and Proposed Reductions
items.summary: The proposal includes $2.7 million in fixed cost increases for salaries and special education, offset by $772,000 in reductions from staff adjustments and the cancellation of unused technology platforms.

items.title: Staffing Investments and Elementary Schedule Changes
items.summary: Recommended investments include literacy coaches and converting library aides to librarians to support a new elementary schedule that eliminates Wednesday early releases to provide more teacher planning time.

items.title: ESSER Funding and Long-term Fiscal Risks
items.summary: The district plans to spend $2.67 million in ESSER funds on critical personnel in FY24, leading Member Ruseau to warn of a major funding cliff when the grant expires in FY25.

items.title: Grants and Revolving Accounts Report
items.summary: The administration reviewed supplemental funding sources and agreed to provide a more detailed transparency report on revolving accounts during the fall session.

items.title: Budget Hearing and Adoption Timeline
items.summary: The committee scheduled a public hearing and a formal vote on the budget request for June 5, with final adoption of the city's appropriation expected later in June.
